name: 年次有給休暇 (annual paid leave)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(1)–(3), (10) with 施行規則 art.24の3: the grant needs 80% attendance over the six months or the year before the grant day. Work-injury, childcare, family care and maternity leave count as attended (art.39(10)), as does annual leave taken (昭22.9.13 発基17). A short schedule takes the table for its weekly or yearly days.

労働基準法 art.39(1)–(2): 10 working days after six months’ continuous service, then 11, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 from six years six months. art.115: the right lapses two years after it arises, so only the previous year’s unused days carry (厚生労働省 Q&A).

name: 産前休業 (prenatal leave)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.65(1): on request, from 6 weeks before the expected birth (14 weeks for a multiple pregnancy); the day of birth counts as prenatal and a birth later than expected extends the leave. The employer need not pay; 健康保険法 art.102 pays the 出産手当金 (two thirds of the standard daily remuneration) and art.159 exempts the premiums on the employer's application.

name: 産後休業 (postnatal leave)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.65(2): no work for 8 weeks after the birth (after 6 weeks the woman may work where a doctor approves). 健康保険法 art.102: 出産手当金 paid by the insurer; premiums exempt (健保法 art.159, 厚年法 art.81の2の2). Metered per birth (facts.event_id): 56 days from the day after the birth.

name: 育児休業 (childcare leave)

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.5–9: until the child is 1, extendable to 1½ and 2 where no childcare place is available, in up to two periods; 雇用保険法 arts.61の7 and 61の10: the 育児休業給付金 (67% for 180 days, then 50%) and, from April 2025, the 出生後休業支援給付金 are paid by employment insurance; health and pension premiums are exempt on application (健保法 art.159, 厚年法 art.81の2).

name: 出生時育児休業 (産後パパ育休)

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.9の2–9の5: up to 4 weeks within 8 weeks of the birth, in up to two periods, requested 2 weeks ahead; 雇用保険法 art.61の8: 出生時育児休業給付金 paid by employment insurance. Metered per birth (facts.event_id): 28 days.

name: 介護休業 (family care leave)

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.11–15: up to 93 days for each family member in need of constant care, in up to three periods; 雇用保険法 art.61の4: 介護休業給付金 (67%) paid by employment insurance. Metered per family member (entry.facts.care_recipient_id): 93 days in all.

name: 子の看護等休暇 (child nursing leave)

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の2 as amended from 1 April 2025: 5 days a business year (10 for two or more children) up to the end of the child's third year of elementary school, for illness, injury, vaccination, health checks, school closure, entrance or graduation ceremonies; in hours where requested; the law does not require pay. The business year runs from 1 April unless the work rules say otherwise (art.16の2(1) "一の年度").

name: 介護休暇 (family care days)

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の5: 5 days a business year from 1 April (10 for two or more family members needing care), takeable in hours; unpaid by law.

name: 生理休暇 (menstrual leave)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.68: a woman for whom work on menstruation days is very difficult may not be made to work on request; the law does not require pay.

name: 公民権行使の時間 (civic duty time off)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.7: time needed to vote, serve as a lay judge (裁判員法 art.100) or perform a public duty must be granted; the law does not require pay.

name: 私傷病欠勤 (sickness absence)

references.title: No statutory paid sick leave; 健康保険法 art.99 pays the 傷病手当金 (two thirds of the standard daily remuneration) from the fourth consecutive day of incapacity for up to 1 year 6 months in aggregate.

name: 業務災害による休業 (occupational injury absence)

references.title: 労働者災害補償保険法 art.14: from the fourth day of absence the 休業補償給付 (60% of the 給付基礎日額, plus a 20% special payment) is paid by the insurance; the first three days are the employer's (労働基準法 art.76; adhoc INJURY_WAITING_COMPENSATION). art.19: no dismissal during the absence and 30 days after.

name: 無給休暇・欠勤 (unpaid leave)

references.title: Leave or absence the work rules leave unpaid (労働基準法 art.89(i) and the no-work-no-pay principle, 民法 art.624(1)); deducted by NO_PAY_LEAVE.

name: 時間単位年休 (annual leave in hours)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(4) with 施行規則 art.24の4: under a labour-management agreement up to 5 days a year of annual leave may be taken in hours, the days drawn on the annual leave; a day is the scheduled daily hours, a part hour rounded up. Planned leave (計画的付与, art.39(6)) is a scheduling of the same days.

name: 育児時間 (nursing time)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.67: a woman with a child under one may claim two periods of at least 30 minutes a day besides her breaks; the law does not require pay.

name: 妊産婦の保健指導・健康診査 (prenatal and postnatal health checks)

references.title: 男女雇用機会均等法 arts.12–13 with 施行規則 art.2の4: the employer must allow the time a pregnant or post-partum worker needs for health guidance and checks (every 4 weeks to week 23, 2 weeks to 35, then weekly) and act on the doctor's instructions; the law does not require pay.

name: 代替休暇 (substitute leave for overtime beyond 60 hours)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.37(3) with 施行規則 art.19の2: paid leave in place of the extra 25% for overtime beyond 60 hours, taken within two months, in half days or days, under a labour-management agreement; it reduces OVERTIME_OVER_60 by OVERTIME_SUBSTITUTED.
